en.title: Immunity
en.who: Guests who mark catching every cold going around, kids bringing everything home, getting sick after a busy stretch, getting sick after short sleep, a trip or flu season coming up, or only taking vitamin C once a cold starts.
studyWhy: why health management is about immunity
most illness starts in the gut

say: I totally get it. Someone at work sneezes, and a few days later it's you. Or you push through a crazy busy stretch, and the moment it's over, you're the one in bed.
feel.tip: Say back what they marked, in their words. Then ask: "When does it usually get you?"

say: Honestly, I've been there. [Your story in a line or two: when it was, what it felt like, what you tried that didn't work.]
felt.tip: Your own story, or someone close to you ("my mom", "a friend from work"). No story yet? "A lot of the people I talk to say exactly the same thing." Never make one up.

say: What I learned is that the immune system isn't a muscle you can pump up. It rebuilds itself every day out of protein and vitamins, and a big part of it lives in your gut. When the gut is out of balance or the supply runs short, it just has less left for everything else.

And sleep matters more than anything in a bottle. The vitamins work as a daily habit, not a rescue: starting vitamin C once the cold is already there doesn't really do much. Nothing stops every cold, so the goal is simply not to run short.
So this is what I'd start with.
found.tip: Two or three sentences, then go to the map. Pick the row that matches what they marked.

map: Catches every cold going around
Probiotic, with cool water, not hot, plus Prebiotic Fiber
A big part of the immune system lives in the gut. Judge it at four weeks
Kids bring everything home
g&h Protect Hand Soap; Kids Daily Chewable Multivitamin, or Kids Toddler Immunity Drops under about three
Hands that don't crack keep getting washed, and kids need a format they'll actually take
Sick after a busy stretch, toast for breakfast
Plant Protein Powder at breakfast, and Double X
Antibodies are made of protein; the multivitamin covers the everyday zinc, selenium and iron
Sleeps short, then gets sick
Magnesium, in the evening
Helps the body wind down so the seven hours actually happen. The habit does the work
Deadline weeks, sleep slipping
Immunity Defense Zinc + Holy Basil, for the stretch only
Not all year. Keep zinc from all sources under 40 mg a day
A trip or flu season coming up
Immunity Echinacea, Twist Tubes, g&h Protect Hand Sanitizer
Use them for the stretch, then stop. Sanitiser is for when there's no soap, not instead of it
Takes vitamin C only once it starts
Vitamin C Extended Release every day, and Vitamin D
A daily habit, not a rescue. Indoors most of the day? Ask the doctor for a vitamin D test
Wants the routine not to lapse
Everyday Nutrition Solution, on a monthly order
Multivitamin, protein and omega-3 together, so the busy week doesn't break the habit
en.ask: Based on what you told me, I'd start with the Probiotic, the daily Vitamin C, and a scoop of protein at breakfast. Do you want to take it home tonight?
en.doctor: A fever for more than three days, trouble breathing, infections that keep coming back, or any fever in a baby under three months? See a doctor first.

zh.title: 免疫力
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了别人一感冒就中招、孩子一上学全家轮着病、一忙完就病倒、一熬夜就感冒、要出门旅行或流感季快到了，或者感冒了才想起吃维C的客人。

say: 我特别懂。办公室有人打个喷嚏，过几天就轮到你了。或者拼命忙完一阵，刚一放松，人就倒下了。
feel.tip: 用对方自己的话，把问卷上勾的说回去。然后问一句：“一般是什么时候最容易中招？”

say: 说实话，我也经历过。[你的故事，一两句就好：什么时候、什么感觉、试过什么没用。]
felt.tip: 讲你自己的，或者身边人的（“我妈妈”“我一个同事”）。还没有故事？就说：“我身边很多朋友也是这样。”千万别编。

say: 我后来才知道，免疫力不是肌肉，练不大。它每天都在用蛋白质和维生素给自己更新，而且很大一部分就在肠道里。肠道一乱，或者原料跟不上，它对外面的东西就顾不过来了。
还有，睡眠比瓶子里的任何东西都重要。营养素要每天吃才有用，感冒了才想起吃维C，其实帮不了多少。没有什么能让人一次都不感冒，我们要做的，就是别让它缺。
所以，我会先从这个开始。
found.tip: 两三句就够，然后看下面的对照表，挑跟对方勾的那一项对得上的。

map: 别人一感冒就中招
益生菌，用凉白开送服，别用热水；加益生元纤维粉
免疫系统很大一部分在肠道里。吃满四周再看
孩子一上学全家轮着病
g&h洗手液；儿童咀嚼综合营养片，三岁左右以前用幼儿免疫滴剂
手不干裂，全家才愿意好好洗；给孩子补，关键是他愿意吃的形式
一忙完就病倒，早餐随便对付
早餐加一勺有机植物蛋白粉，再加双X综合营养片
抗体是蛋白质做的；双X把锌、硒、铁的日常量打好底
一熬夜就感冒
镁片，晚上吃
帮身体放松下来，七小时才睡得满。真正起作用的是习惯
赶项目、睡不够的那几周
锌+圣罗勒免疫片，只在这段时间吃
不是一年到头吃。所有来源加起来，锌每天不超过40毫克
要出门旅行、流感季快到了
紫锥菊免疫片、随身营养饮管、g&h免洗洗手液
就用这一段，过了就停。免洗洗手液是没有肥皂时用的，不是代替洗手
感冒了才想起吃维C
维生素C缓释片每天吃，加维生素D
是日常习惯，不是救急。常待在室内的，请医生查一下维生素D
怕一忙起来习惯就断
每日基础营养方案，设成每月自动送货
综合营养片、蛋白粉、鱼油一次配齐，最累的那一周也不断
zh.ask: 按你刚才说的，我建议先从益生菌、每天的维C，还有早餐加一勺蛋白粉开始。今天要不要先带回去？
zh.doctor: 发烧超过三天、呼吸困难、感染反反复复，或者三个月以下的宝宝发烧，请先去看医生。
